title: Scope a folder named plainly "mock" as test code
target_unit: addTestConventions() (63 LOC, high) in ScopingConventions (file of 514 LOC, high risk)
notes: The reference change is +7/-2 (two pattern strings plus a five-line comment): the two mock-folder test conventions .*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.* and .*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.* become .*/__mock[^/]*/.* and .*/mock[^/]*/.*. The diff applies to the snapshot as is (the reference commit also adds its own test, ScopingConventionsMockFoldersTest, which is not part of the task). In B the rules live in the helper TestConventions (84 lines). The acceptance test goes through new ScopingConventions().getTestFilesConventions() and Convention.pathMatches: a plain 'mock' folder (incl. the elasticsearch path, a relative '../' path, '__mock', a backslash path), punctuation and non-ASCII names, the previously matching folders, and negatives ('remock/', 'demo/', 'mock.java', 'mockery.java', '../src/main/java/App.java'). Verification: A before — compiles, 2 of 4 fail (the plain-mock and the punctuation/non-ASCII tests; assertion failures), the regression and negative tests pass; A after (reference diff via patch -p1) — 4/4 pass, module 343 tests green; B before — compiles unchanged, the same 2 fail; B after (same two string edits in TestConventions) — 4/4 pass, module 343 tests green.
